```{python}
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

subject = r.params["subject"]
export_dir = Path(r.params["export_dir"])
metrics = json.loads((export_dir / f"{subject}_metrics.json").read_text())
directions = pd.read_csv(export_dir / f"{subject}_directions.csv")
sliding = pd.read_csv(export_dir / f"{subject}_sliding_dci.csv")

source_dirs_path = export_dir / f"{subject}_source_directions.csv"
source_dci_path  = export_dir / f"{subject}_source_dci.csv"
source_roi_path  = export_dir / f"{subject}_source_roi_summary.csv"
trials_path      = export_dir / f"{subject}_trials.csv"

source_dirs = pd.read_csv(source_dirs_path) if source_dirs_path.exists() else None
source_dci  = pd.read_csv(source_dci_path)  if source_dci_path.exists()  else None
source_roi  = pd.read_csv(source_roi_path)  if source_roi_path.exists()  else None
trials      = pd.read_csv(trials_path)      if trials_path.exists()      else None
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

# Shared ggplot2 theme for all plots in this report
theme_mous <- function(base_size = 13) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1, color = "#0f172a"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "#64748b", size = base_size - 1, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "#475569", size = base_size - 1),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "#64748b"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e2e8f0"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#1e293b"),
      legend.position  = "none"
    )
}

COND_COLORS <- c("ZINNEN" = "#2563eb", "WOORDEN" = "#16a34a", "REST" = "#d97706")
```

## Key Metrics

```{python}
_labels = {
    "run_status":                    "Run status",
    "n_trials":                      "Total trials",
    "n_zinnen":                      "ZINNEN trials",
    "n_woorden":                     "WOORDEN trials",
    "n_rest":                        "REST pseudo-epochs",
    "dci_zinnen":                    "Mean DCI – ZINNEN",
    "dci_woorden":                   "Mean DCI – WOORDEN",
    "dci_rest":                      "Mean DCI – REST",
    "p_task_vs_rest":                "p (task vs REST, permutation)",
    "p_woorden_vs_rest":             "p (WOORDEN vs REST)",
    "p_zinnen_vs_woorden":           "p (ZINNEN vs WOORDEN)",
    "p_rayleigh_zinnen":             "Rayleigh p – ZINNEN",
    "p_rayleigh_woorden":            "Rayleigh p – WOORDEN",
    "aim1_prestim_auc":              "Pre-stim β AUC (AIM 1)",
    "aim1_n400m_zinnen_vs_woorden_t": "N400m t (AIM 1)",
    "aim1_dci_block_effect_p":       "DCI block-effect p (AIM 1)",
}

def _fmt(v):
    if isinstance(v, float):
        return f"{v:.4g}"
    return str(v)

rows = [
    {"Metric": _labels.get(k, k), "Value": _fmt(metrics[k])}
    for k in _labels
    if k in metrics
]
pd.DataFrame(rows).style.hide(axis="index")
```

## Direction Distributions

```{r}
#| label: fig-directions
#| fig-cap: "Polar histograms of wave propagation directions per condition (36 bins)."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4

dirs <- read.csv(file.path(params$export_dir, paste0(params$subject, "_directions.csv")))
ggplot(dirs, aes(x = direction_rad, fill = condition)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 36, position = "identity", alpha = 0.75, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_polar() +
  facet_wrap(~condition, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COND_COLORS) +
  theme_mous() +
  labs(
    title    = paste("Wave direction distributions –", params$subject),
    subtitle = "Each panel shows the angular distribution of sensor-space traveling waves",
    x = NULL, y = "Count"
  )
```

## Sliding DCI

```{r}
#| label: fig-sliding-dci
#| fig-cap: "Directionality Consistency Index (DCI) over time for ZINNEN trials. Dashed line = chance (0.5)."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 3.5

slide <- read.csv(file.path(params$export_dir, paste0(params$subject, "_sliding_dci.csv")))
ggplot(slide, aes(x = time_s, y = dci)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0.5, ymax = pmax(dci, 0.5)), fill = "#bfdbfe", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(color = "#2563eb", linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#94a3b8", linewidth = 0.7) +
  theme_mous() +
  labs(
    title    = paste("Sliding DCI – ZINNEN:", params$subject),
    subtitle = "Blue shading = above-chance directionality",
    x = "Time (s)", y = "DCI"
  )
```

## Source-Space Summary (m5)

```{python}
m5_keys = [
    "source_dci_zinnen", "source_directions_count",
    "m5_n_labels", "m5_n_stcs", "m5_error", "m5_skipped_reason",
]
m5_labels = {
    "source_dci_zinnen":       "Source DCI – ZINNEN",
    "source_directions_count": "Source direction count",
    "m5_n_labels":             "ROI labels",
    "m5_n_stcs":               "Source estimates (STCs)",
    "m5_error":                "Error",
    "m5_skipped_reason":       "Skipped reason",
}
m5_rows = [
    {"Metric": m5_labels.get(k, k), "Value": _fmt(metrics[k])}
    for k in m5_keys if k in metrics
]
if m5_rows:
    pd.DataFrame(m5_rows).style.hide(axis="index")
else:
    print("m5 metrics not present (stage may have been skipped).")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-source-directions
#| fig-cap: "Source-space wave direction distribution (ZINNEN), parcellated across all ROI labels."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4

source_dirs_file <- file.path(params$export_dir, paste0(params$subject, "_source_directions.csv"))
source_dci_file  <- file.path(params$export_dir, paste0(params$subject, "_source_dci.csv"))

if (file.exists(source_dirs_file)) {
  src_dirs <- read.csv(source_dirs_file)
  ggplot(src_dirs, aes(x = source_direction_rad)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 36, fill = "#7c3aed", color = "white", alpha = 0.85, linewidth = 0.2) +
    coord_polar() +
    theme_mous() +
    labs(
      title    = paste("Source-space directions (ZINNEN):", params$subject),
      subtitle = "Pooled across all parcels",
      x = NULL, y = "Count"
    )
} else {
  cat("No source-direction CSV found (m5 skipped or not yet run).\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-source-dci
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of trial-wise source-space DCI values. Dashed line = chance (0.5)."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 3.5

if (file.exists(source_dci_file)) {
  src_dci <- read.csv(source_dci_file)
  ggplot(src_dci, aes(x = source_dci)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#7c3aed", color = "white", alpha = 0.85, linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#94a3b8", linewidth = 0.8) +
    theme_mous() +
    labs(
      title    = paste("Source DCI distribution:", params$subject),
      subtitle = "Trial-level directionality in source space",
      x = "Source DCI", y = "Count"
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-roi-summary

roi_file <- file.path(params$export_dir, paste0(params$subject, "_source_roi_summary.csv"))
if (file.exists(roi_file)) {
  roi <- read.csv(roi_file)
  roi_summary <- roi |>
    group_by(label) |>
    summarise(
      mean_beta = mean(mean_beta, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_beta   = sd(mean_beta,  na.rm = TRUE),
      n_epochs  = n(),
      .groups   = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(mean_beta))
  kable(roi_summary, digits = 4, caption = "Mean beta power by ROI label (m5 source space)")
}
```
